message.content:
An editorial illustration features a red magazine cover titled "TEMPO" with a small "55" in the upper right. Below the title, the main image depicts a large, light-skinned man with short dark hair, squinting his eyes and wearing a white short-sleeved shirt. He is positioned inside and behind a yellow-framed structure resembling a claw machine. He holds two red joysticks, appearing to operate a metal mechanical claw suspended by a segmented cable on the left. The claw hangs over a shallow yellow tray. Numerous small, multi-colored spheres—red, yellow, and blue—are scattered around the base of the machine. The man’s larger torso and right arm extend beyond the right side of the machine frame against a dark background.

White text overlays the center: "PILAH-PILIH MENTERI KEUANGAN". Smaller white text to the left reads: "Presiden Prabowo mencari Menteri Keuangan baru untuk jadi gimik kebijakan ekonomi. Para calon jiper terhadap proyek makan bergizi dan koperasi merah putih. H.58". Other headlines and a barcode are visible at the top and bottom.
